newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 5.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 5.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The chairman and controlling shareholder of Seven Network Ltd, Kerry Stokes, has threatened to sell his 24.9 percent stake in the television broadcaster if the government changes foreign ownership rules as well as cross-media rules, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said.

Potential changes to media ownership laws could allow New Ltd to increase its holding in Channel Seven from 14 percent to 25 percent, the Sydney Morning Herald report said. Fletcher Challenge Paper said it has held talks with News Ltd over increasing its stake in the 50 percent News-owned Australian Newsprint Mills (ANM).

Building products group James Hardie Industries Ltd said it expected its profit after tax for the current year to March 31 to improve significantly compared to the past year. Hardie earlier reported a sharply improved net profit for the year to March 31 of A$83.0 million.
Manufacturing group Email Ltd said it expected to record further improved results in 1997/98, after posting a higher profit before abnormals of A$58.7 million for the year to March 31, 1997.
